question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "depth".
solution:
The correct answer is: **4) Shallowness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"depth"** refers to the quality of being deep, whether physically or metaphorically. It can also mean profoundness or intensity in thought or emotion. (गहराई)
 
 
• **Example:** The depth of his knowledge in science is truly remarkable.
 
 
• **"Shallowness"** is the opposite of "depth," meaning a lack of depth, either physically or metaphorically. It can refer to superficiality or a lack of seriousness or thought. (उथलापन)
 
 
• **Example:** The conversation lacked substance and was marked by its shallowness.
 
 
• Hence, the most opposite word to **'depth'** is **'shallowness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **4) Shallowness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intensity** (तीव्रता): Refers to the degree or magnitude of strength, force, or emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
 
 
 
• **Abyss** (अथाह गहराई): Refers to a deep or seemingly bottomless chasm, often metaphorically used to describe a profound void.
 
 
• **Example:** Staring into the abyss of the canyon was both terrifying and mesmerizing.
 
 
 
• **Profundity** (गहनता): Refers to the quality of being profound or insightful, especially in thought or knowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** The speaker's profundity left the audience in awe.
